_comment: City-and-date context engine. RAG domains are metadata filters (knowledge sections) applied before ranking; tips are rules over retrieved data, each carrying the fact it rests on.

place.query: overview history significance what makes this place special

culture.query: local customs etiquette culture traditions dress

text.rain: Carry an umbrella or a light rain jacket; showers are likely ({detail}).
text.heat: Plan open-air sightseeing for early morning or late afternoon and carry water (feels like up to {apparent}°C).
text.uv: UV is very high ({uv}); use sunscreen, a hat and sunglasses.
text.cool: It gets cool (down to {min}°C); pack a warm layer for mornings and evenings.
text.mild: Light, breathable clothing suits the day ({min}–{max}°C).
text.crowd: {event} is on ({dates}); expect crowds and traffic around it and allow extra travel time.
text.peak: It's peak tourist season here; book stays and popular sites in advance.
text.off_peak: It's outside peak season, so expect fewer crowds.
